name: Reading Rating
description: Rates the readability of text-field content in the edit form using the Flesch–Kincaid formula, updating live as the editor types.
project_description:
This module will allow any long text field to be evaluated for readability using the Flesch–Kincaid readability algorithm. This module works with CKEditor5 as well as non-WYSIWYG text fields and is configurable per text field. Rating results update in real-time. The module now supports translatable and configurable ratings. It also supports grade-level ratings.

 Post-Installation 
 
 Visit the form display for a content type, block type, paragraph, etc. 
 Click the gear icon to the right of the field to open up the settings for that field form display. 
 Expand the details for "Reading Rating" and click the checkbox to enable Reading Rating for this field. 
 Optionally, you may enable grade level ratings. 
 Click "Update" on the field, and then save the form display. 
 Visit the edit page for the node type that was just edited above. 
 There is now a "Reading Rating" section below the text field that will automatically show the rating as you type. 
 
 Planned Features 
 
 Add additional readability algorithms 
 Allow summary fields to be rated
